attributes.residual: 64 lines, ONE named mechanism plus its downstream colouring. MECHANISM: StartShieldFX's target holds TWO INCOMPATIBLE FORMS of the same element address in one function - an EARLY two-use pre-offset pointer (`lwz 2996(p); addi p,p,2976`, reproduced correctly by the baseline's `ep`/`ro` shape and again by axis 4's info[] carrier) and a LATE fully-rematerialized index (`mulli; add; lwz 2996`) at the second MBTreeSetFlags call. Reaching the late form requires NO shared prescaled index anywhere in the function, but removing the shared index is precisely what destroys the early form: axis 3 removed it and the early region collapsed into an `lwzu` update form, losing 4 instructions. So the two requirements are mutually exclusive under every source spelling measured. BOUNDARY ESTABLISHED on claim.law.cached-base-alias-defeats-rematerialized-index-base.20260831.v1: that law's 'the conversion is all-or-nothing, trust the multiset and finish rather than reverting' procedure is CORRECT as a procedure but does NOT converge here, because this function's target is not uniformly rematerialized - it is MIXED, and the law's all-or-nothing prescription drives past the target rather than onto it. The law should be read as applying only when the target rematerializes at EVERY access of the element; check that first by counting the target's `add rX,rBase,rIdx` occurrences against its field-access count. Here they disagree. NOT WEBFRANK-READY: the streams differ in actual instructions (target has a `mulli`+`add` pair ours lacks entirely, and lwz-vs-lwzx is a different addressing mode, not a colour), so the renaming-bisimulation stage does not apply, and the add/lwz pair is data-DEPENDENT so the permutation stage's independent-atom requirement fails. Do not flag it. DO-NOT-RETRY the association/rematerialization axis on this function without a genuinely new mechanism for holding BOTH forms simultaneously; the four spellings above are exhausted and the single-use reading of the target's late pre-offset pointer says no spelling reaches it.
